info.title: Pidgeon.CLI
info.description: Generate, validate, inspect, and de-identify synthetic HL7, FHIR, and NCPDP messages for healthcare integration testing.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Free-core CLI: generate, validate, deident, data, artifacts, lookup, find, path, run, session, completions

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Enable verbose output

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress status output (only emit data to stdout)

options.name: --output-format
options.description: Stdout format: text|json (default: text). Subcommands may also accept their own --output for output paths.

commands.name: artifacts
commands.description: Search installable artifacts — recipes and data packages; for standards reference data use lookup/find; for clinical scenarios use catalog

commands.name: search
commands.description: Search local artifacts by term

options.name: --kind
options.description: Filter by artifact kind: vendor-profile | generation-config | workflow | conform-endpoint | flock-population-config | engagement-pack | data-package

options.name: --vendor
options.description: Filter by vendor (e.g., epic, cerner)

options.name: --standard
options.description: Filter by standard (e.g., hl7, fhir)

options.name: --message-type
options.description: Filter by message type (e.g., ADT^A01)

options.name: --installed
options.description: Only artifacts already installed on this machine

options.name: --limit
options.description: Maximum results to return (default 20, max 100)

arguments.name: QUERY
arguments.description: Search terms matched against artifact titles, descriptions, names, vendors, and message types

options.name: --standard

commands.name: list
commands.description: List available and installed data packages

commands.name: install

options.name: --all

options.name: --accept-license

arguments.name: PACKAGE

commands.name: deident

options.name: --date-shift
options.description: Shift dates by +/-N days (e.g., 30d, -14d)

options.name: --keep-ids
options.description: Comma-list of identifiers to keep unhashed (e.g., visitId)

options.name: --salt
options.description: Salt for deterministic hashing

options.name: --preview
options.description: Show sample before/after rows without writing files

options.name: --in
options.description: File or folder of source data (redundant - use positional args)

options.name: --out

arguments.name: INPUT
arguments.description: File or folder of source data

arguments.name: OUTPUT
arguments.description: Output file/folder (created if missing)

commands.name: find
commands.description: 🔍 Search engine for healthcare message discovery and field location

options.name: --field
options.description: Search for field paths/locations

options.name: --value
options.description: Search for specific values in messages

options.name: --pattern
options.description: Pattern matching (wildcards: *, regex supported)

options.name: --map
options.description: Show cross-standard field mappings

options.name: --semantic
options.description: Semantic search (find related clinical concepts)

options.name: --standard
options.description: Limit to specific standard (hl7v23, fhir-r4, ncpdp)

options.name: --type
options.description: Message/resource type filter (e.g., ADT, Patient, NewRx)

options.name: --in
options.description: Search within specific files/directories

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: table|json|paths

options.name: --limit
options.description: Maximum number of results

options.name: --detailed
options.description: Show detailed field information

arguments.name: QUERY
arguments.description: Search query: field path, value, or semantic term (e.g., 'patient.mrn', 'M123456', 'medication')

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Generate synthetic messages/resources with smart standard inference

options.name: --count
options.description: Number of messages to generate

options.name: --output
options.description: Output file path (optional, defaults to console)

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: auto|hl7|json|ndjson

options.name: --mode
options.description: Generation mode: procedural|model|api

options.name: --seed
options.description: Deterministic seed for reproducible data

options.name: --vendor
options.description: Apply vendor pattern (e.g., epic, cerner, meditech)

options.name: --hl7-version
options.description: HL7 version for generation; use --hl7-version list to see supported versions

options.name: --session
options.description: Use specific session (overrides current session)

options.name: --no-session
options.description: Force pure random generation (ignore current session)

options.name: --as-of
options.description: Wall-clock instant to stamp messages with (ISO 8601, e.g. 2025-03-01T08:00). Defaults to the real current time; recorded in the manifest for replay.

options.name: --manifest
options.description: Write a run-manifest (effective seed + clock + options) to this path so the run can be replayed with --from-manifest.

options.name: --from-manifest
options.description: Replay a run from a manifest written by --manifest. The message-type argument is taken from the manifest.

options.name: --share
options.description: Write a shareable .pidgeonrun envelope (manifest + verification hash + run id) to this path. Runs the SHARE-PROFILE gate; a non-shareable run exits 1 with the reasons listed.

options.name: --title
options.description: Optional title recorded in a shared run's metadata (used with --share).

options.name: --description
options.description: Optional description recorded in a shared run's metadata (used with --share).

options.name: --by
options.description: Optional author string recorded in a shared run's metadata (used with --share). Never auto-filled.

arguments.name: MESSAGE_TYPES
arguments.description: Message type (e.g., ADT^A01, Patient, NewRx) - supports 239+ HL7/FHIR/NCPDP types

commands.name: lookup
commands.description: Look up healthcare standards definitions with smart inference

options.name: --search
options.description: Search across all standards for elements matching query

options.name: --standard
options.description: Explicit standard (hl7v23, fhir-r4, ncpdp)

options.name: --vendor
options.description: Show vendor-specific variations (epic, cerner, allscripts)

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: text|json|table

options.name: --segments
options.description: List all segments/resources in specified standard

options.name: --children
options.description: List child elements of specified path

options.name: --examples
options.description: Show detailed examples and usage patterns

options.name: --cross-ref
options.description: Show cross-references to other standards

options.name: --inter
options.description: Beta: Interactive TUI browsing mode (in development)

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Element path (e.g., PID.3.5, Patient.identifier, NewRx.Patient) - leave empty to browse

commands.name: path
commands.description: Discover and explore semantic field paths across healthcare standards

commands.name: list
commands.description: Discover available semantic paths for a message type

options.name: --standard
options.description: Show paths for specific standard (hl7v23|fhirv4|ncpdp)

options.name: --category
options.description: Filter by category: patient|encounter|provider|medication|all

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: table|json|csv

options.name: --descriptions
options.description: Include field descriptions (verbose)

options.name: --examples
options.description: Show example values for each path

options.name: --output
options.description: Write results to file (default: stdout)

arguments.name: MESSAGE_TYPE
arguments.description: HL7 message (ADT^A01), FHIR resource (Patient), or NCPDP type (NewRx). If omitted, shows universal paths.

commands.name: resolve
commands.description: Show how a semantic path maps to standard-specific field locations

options.name: --standard
options.description: Show mapping for specific standard only

options.name: --all-standards
options.description: Show mappings across all supported standards

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: table|json

options.name: --detailed
options.description: Include field type, validation rules, and examples

options.name: --path-only
options.description: Output only the resolved path (useful for scripting)

arguments.name: SEMANTIC_PATH
arguments.description: Semantic path to resolve (e.g., patient.mrn, encounter.location)

arguments.name: MESSAGE_TYPE
arguments.description: Target message type (ADT^A01, Patient, NewRx)

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Check if a semantic path is valid for a given message type

options.name: --standard
options.description: Validate against specific standard

options.name: --suggestions
options.description: Show related/alternative paths when invalid

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: text|json

arguments.name: SEMANTIC_PATH
arguments.description: Path to validate (e.g., medication.dosage)

arguments.name: MESSAGE_TYPE
arguments.description: Target message type (ADT^A01, Patient, etc.)

commands.name: search
commands.description: Find semantic paths by keyword or description

options.name: --message-type
options.description: Limit search to specific message type

options.name: --standard
options.description: Limit search to specific standard

options.name: --category
options.description: Limit search to category (patient|encounter|provider|medication)

options.name: --exact
options.description: Exact match only (no fuzzy search)

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: table|json

arguments.name: QUERY
arguments.description: Search term (e.g., "phone", "date", "medical record")

commands.name: run
commands.description: Work with shareable .pidgeonrun run artifacts: replay, verify, show, diff, fork, link

commands.name: replay
commands.description: Reproduce a run's bytes from its artifact

options.name: --output
options.description: Output file or folder for the reproduced messages (defaults to stdout)

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: auto|hl7|json|ndjson

options.name: --yes
options.description: Confirm replay of a large run (count above the count-bomb threshold)

arguments.name: ARTIFACT
arguments.description: A .pidgeonrun envelope, a bare run manifest, an r1. payload, or a share URL

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Prove an artifact reproduces byte-identically on this machine, offline

options.name: --best-effort
options.description: Verify anyway across a determinism-version mismatch, attributing the skew prominently

options.name: --yes
options.description: Confirm verification of a large run (count above the count-bomb threshold)

arguments.name: ARTIFACT
arguments.description: A .pidgeonrun envelope, an r1. payload, or a share URL (a bare manifest has no proof block)

commands.name: show
commands.description: Render an artifact's config, seed, clock, hashes, versions, and lineage (no generation)

arguments.name: ARTIFACT
arguments.description: A .pidgeonrun envelope, a bare run manifest, an r1. payload, or a share URL

commands.name: diff
commands.description: Compare two artifacts at the config level plus their output hashes (free)

arguments.name: A
arguments.description: First artifact (file, r1. payload, or share URL)

arguments.name: B
arguments.description: Second artifact (file, r1. payload, or share URL)

commands.name: fork
commands.description: Derive a child run with a memory of its parent (regenerates and rehashes)

options.name: --set
options.description: Override a procedural knob as key=value (repeatable). Allowed: seed, count, as_of, message_type, standard, patient_type, clinical_scenario_id, vendor_profile, hl7_version, ncpdp_version, is_cohort_sequence

options.name: --output
options.description: Path to write the forked child .pidgeonrun

options.name: --title
options.description: Optional title recorded in the child's metadata

options.name: --description
options.description: Optional description recorded in the child's metadata

arguments.name: ARTIFACT
arguments.description: Parent .pidgeonrun envelope, bare manifest, r1. payload, or share URL to fork from

commands.name: link
commands.description: Encode an artifact as a shareable r1. link + account-portal share URL (offline, nothing stored)

arguments.name: ARTIFACT
arguments.description: A .pidgeonrun envelope path, a bare r1. payload, or a share URL to re-encode as a link

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show current session status

commands.name: save
commands.description: Save temporary session with a permanent name

arguments.name: NAME

commands.name: create

options.name: --description
options.description: Description for the session

arguments.name: NAME

commands.name: use
commands.description: Switch to existing session

arguments.name: NAME

commands.name: list
commands.description: List all sessions with status

commands.name: show
commands.description: Show session details

commands.name: clear
commands.description: Clear current session

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Remove specific session

arguments.name: NAME

commands.name: export

options.name: --session

commands.name: import
commands.description: Import session template

options.name: --name

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: Template file path (JSON format)

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate healthcare messages against standards

options.name: --mode
options.description: Validation mode (Strict, Compatibility, Lenient)

options.name: --standard
options.description: Specific standard to validate against (auto-detect if not specified)

options.name: --profile
options.description: Vendor profile name to validate against

options.name: --file
options.description: Path to file (redundant - use positional args instead)

options.name: --report
options.description: Write a validation report to this path (HTML with failures and guidance, or raw JSON when the path ends in .json)

options.name: --clinical
options.description: Run deterministic clinical checks (advisory, free, offline) beside spec validation

options.name: --semantic
options.description: Run the advisory on-device semantic review (clinical-sense LLM judge) beside spec validation

arguments.name: FILES
arguments.description: Path(s) to message file(s) to validate (supports wildcards)
